note: 泪水 is the literary/emotional word; 眼泪 is the everyday one.

examples.zh: 她的泪水流了出来。
examples.en: Tears ran down her face.

examples.zh: 他擦干了脸上的泪水。
examples.en: He wiped the tears off his face.

examples.zh: 看完那部电影，很多人都流下了泪水。
examples.en: After that movie, many people shed tears.

meaning: land; dry land (as opposed to sea)

senses.en: land; dry land (as opposed to sea)

note: 陆地 vs 海洋: land vs ocean.

examples.zh: 地球上陆地比大海小。
examples.en: There is less land than sea on Earth.

examples.zh: 坐了三天船，我们终于看到了陆地。
examples.en: After three days on the boat, we finally saw land.

examples.zh: 这种动物只能生活在陆地上。
examples.en: This kind of animal can only live on land.

note: 看动画片 = watch cartoons.

examples.zh: 我儿子每天晚上都看动画片。
examples.en: My son watches cartoons every evening.

examples.zh: 这部动画片很适合全家一起看。
examples.en: This animated film is great for the whole family.

examples.zh: 你小时候喜欢什么动画片？
examples.en: What cartoons did you like as a child?

meaning: nature; character (of a thing or matter)

senses.en: nature; character (of a thing or matter)

note: 工作性质 = the nature of a job; 性质不同 = different in nature.

examples.zh: 这两件事的性质不一样。
examples.en: These two matters are different in nature.

examples.zh: 你的工作是什么性质的？
examples.en: What kind of work do you do?

examples.zh: 他说这是公司的事，不是个人性质的。
examples.en: He said this is a company matter, not a personal one.

note: 生活常识 = everyday know-how; 没常识 = to lack basic knowledge.

examples.zh: 这是生活常识，你怎么不知道？
examples.en: This is basic everyday knowledge; how come you don't know it?

examples.zh: 医生给我们讲了一些健康常识。
examples.en: The doctor told us some general health knowledge.

examples.zh: 孩子要从小学习安全常识。
examples.en: Children should learn basic safety knowledge from a young age.

note: 爱国 is a verb-object phrase but is often used like an adjective: 很爱国.

examples.zh: 他是一个非常爱国的人。
examples.en: He is a very patriotic person.

examples.zh: 学校常常教学生要爱国。
examples.en: Schools often teach students to love their country.

examples.zh: 许多在国外工作的人也很爱国。
examples.en: Many people working abroad are also very patriotic.

note: 应届毕业生 = this year's graduates (common in job ads).

examples.zh: 今年的毕业生比去年多。
examples.en: There are more graduates this year than last year.

examples.zh: 这家公司想找几个毕业生。
examples.en: This company wants to hire a few graduates.

examples.zh: 很多毕业生毕业以后想出国。
examples.en: Many graduates want to go abroad after graduating.

note: Verb-object: 获奖 + 了/者/作品; 获得奖 is not used.

examples.zh: 我的朋友在比赛中获奖了。
examples.en: My friend won an award in the competition.

examples.zh: 这部电影去年获奖了吗？
examples.en: Did this movie win an award last year?

examples.zh: 获奖的同学可以去台上拿奖。
examples.en: Students who won awards can come up to receive them.

note: Opposite: 出口. 进口水果 = imported fruit.

examples.zh: 这些水果都是从国外进口的。
examples.en: These fruits are all imported from abroad.

examples.zh: 我更喜欢买进口牛奶。
examples.en: I prefer to buy imported milk.

examples.zh: 中国每年进口很多东西。
examples.en: China imports a lot of goods every year.

note: 种类 很多 / 种类 不同: the variety is large / different types.

examples.zh: 这家超市的水果种类很多。
examples.en: This supermarket has many kinds of fruit.

examples.zh: 你们店里有哪些种类的茶？
examples.en: What types of tea do you have in your shop?

examples.zh: 世界上鸟的种类非常多。
examples.en: There are very many kinds of birds in the world.

note: 在操场上 = on the sports field; usually part of a school.

examples.zh: 孩子在操场上跑步。
examples.en: The child is running on the sports field.

examples.zh: 学校的操场很大，晚上也有灯。
examples.en: The school's sports field is big and has lights at night too.

examples.zh: 下课后我们去操场打篮球吧。
examples.en: After class let's go play basketball on the sports field.

meaning: to inspect; to make a field study of

senses.en: to inspect; to make a field study of

note: 去…考察 = go on a study trip/inspection; more formal than 看.

examples.zh: 经理下个月要去上海考察。
examples.en: The manager will go to Shanghai next month for an inspection.

examples.zh: 我们考察了三个城市，最后选了这里。
examples.en: We inspected three cities and finally chose this one.

examples.zh: 这次考察对我的研究很有帮助。
examples.en: This field trip was very helpful to my research.

note: 开暖气 = turn on the heating; in northern China it is supplied citywide in winter.

examples.zh: 北方冬天家里都有暖气。
examples.en: In northern China, homes have central heating in winter.

examples.zh: 今天太冷了，把暖气开大一些吧。
examples.en: It's so cold today; turn the heating up a bit.

examples.zh: 我家的暖气坏了，怎么办？
examples.en: The heating at my place is broken; what should I do?

note: 海水 = the water; 大海 = the sea itself.

examples.zh: 海水又咸又凉。
examples.en: Seawater is both salty and cold.

examples.zh: 孩子喝了一口海水，说太咸了。
examples.en: The child took a mouthful of seawater and said it was too salty.

examples.zh: 这里的海水很干净，可以游泳。
examples.en: The seawater here is clean, so you can swim.

meaning: to appreciate; to admire (a sight); to reward

senses.en: to appreciate; to admire (a sight); to reward

note: Mostly in compounds: 欣赏 (appreciate), 赞赏, 赏花 (view flowers).

examples.zh: 秋天我们常常去公园赏花。
examples.en: In autumn we often go to the park to view flowers.

examples.zh: 老板赏了他一个红包。
examples.en: The boss gave him a red envelope as a reward.

examples.zh: 月亮很圆，我们一起去赏月吧。
examples.en: The moon is round and bright; let's go enjoy it together.

note: 用途很多 = has many uses; 有什么用途 = what is it used for.

examples.zh: 这个机器有什么用途？
examples.en: What is this machine used for?

examples.zh: 这种包用途很多，也很便宜。
examples.en: This kind of bag has many uses and is cheap.

examples.zh: 请告诉我这笔钱的用途。
examples.en: Please tell me what this money is for.

note: Appears in compounds: 商务舱 (business class), 商务活动, 商务中心.

examples.zh: 他经常坐飞机去外地谈商务。
examples.en: He often flies to other cities to handle business matters.

examples.zh: 我下周要去北京参加一个商务会议。
examples.en: Next week I'm going to Beijing for a business meeting.

examples.zh: 这家酒店有商务中心，可以打印。
examples.en: This hotel has a business center where you can print.

meaning: to admire; to think highly of; to appreciate

senses.en: to admire; to think highly of; to appreciate

note: Warmer and more formal than 称赞; often 得到…的赞赏.

examples.zh: 我很赞赏你的做法。
examples.en: I really admire the way you handled it.

examples.zh: 老板赞赏他的认真。
examples.en: The boss appreciated his conscientiousness.

examples.zh: 她的想法得到了大家的赞赏。
examples.en: Her idea won everyone's admiration.

meaning: older sister; polite address for a woman a bit older

senses.en: older sister; polite address for a woman a bit older

note: Can be used to address a stranger politely: 大姐，请问…

examples.zh: 大姐，请问去地铁站怎么走？
examples.en: Excuse me, ma'am, how do I get to the subway station?

examples.zh: 我大姐今年四十岁，在医院工作。
examples.en: My eldest sister is forty and works at a hospital.

examples.zh: 我家旁边的大姐常常帮我看孩子。
examples.en: The lady next door often helps me look after my child.

note: 读研究生 = study for a master's/PhD; 研究生院 = graduate school.

examples.zh: 我姐姐正在读研究生。
examples.en: My sister is studying for a graduate degree.

examples.zh: 他是我们学校的研究生。
examples.en: He is a graduate student at our school.

examples.zh: 你打算毕业以后考研究生吗？
examples.en: Do you plan to take the graduate entrance exam after you graduate?
